findings.evidence: TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Weights/Sl2System.lean:42-48 and :193-203 (`mul_eq_one_of_eq_smul`: the only constraint on a rescaling is `c * d = 1`); Symmetry.lean:75-79; no `Chevalley involution` for `IsKilling K L` in `./mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Lie` or `./code/TauCeti`.
findings.fix: Reword the docstring and header to say the hypotheses hold for a *Chevalley system* — a normalised family chosen compatibly with the involution — not for an arbitrary `IsSl2System`, so a reader cannot conclude that `N(-α,-β) = -N(α,β)` will follow for any normalised family. Alternatively supply the witness (a system plus an endomorphism realising `x α ↦ -x (-α)`) in this PR; there is currently none in-repo (`serreChevalleyInvolution` lives on `Matrix.ToLieAlgebra R CM`, not on an `IsKilling` `L`) or in Mathlib (no Chevalley involution: grep for `Chevalley` in `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Lie` returns only Jordan–Chevalley and Chevalley–Serre relations).
findings.issue: "A later Chevalley involution supplies them uniformly for every root" is false for a general `IsSl2System`. The canonical involution `ω` (acting as `-1` on `H`) only gives `ω(x α) = c_α • x (-α)` with `c_α * c_(-α) = 1`; `c_α = -1` for all roots is the additional Chevalley-system condition. Rescaling one pair by `x α ↦ t • x α`, `x (-α) ↦ t⁻¹ • x (-α)` preserves `IsSl2System` (cf. `mul_eq_one_of_eq_smul`) yet gives `ω(x α) = -t² • x (-α)`, so the hypotheses `heα/heβ/heγ` fail. `Sl2System.lean:42-48` states the same: "Bourbaki's Chevalley system asks moreover that the family be exchanged with its negatives by the Chevalley involution. Neither condition is imposed here." The module header (line 21-23, "This file proves two symmetries of these constants") inherits the overstatement.

summary: The three statements are mathematically faithful and non-vacuous (I checked the sign conventions, the weight arithmetic, and the Mathlib lemmas used). The only issue is that the endomorphism hypothesis of `structureConstant_neg_neg_of_hom` is documented as forthcoming for free, when it is really the extra Chevalley-system condition on `x` that the repo elsewhere explicitly says is not imposed.
